question: g3_checkout_request
answer:
Created [checkoutRequest.mjs](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g3_checkout_request/no_okf/codex/5/src/util/checkoutRequest.mjs) — a dependency-free ES module exporting `buildCheckoutRequest`, verified with `node --check` and a sample invocation. It returns `{method: "POST", path: "cart/<cartCode>/checkout", body: {...}}` with the body fields `shippingQuote`, `currency`, `isAgree`, `message`, and `payment: {paymentType: "CREDITCARD", transactionType: "CAPTURE", paymentModule, paymentToken, amount}` — the exact names the storefront sends, mapped from the parameter names.

Files I used:
- [src/pages/other/Checkout.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g3_checkout_request/no_okf/codex/5/src/pages/other/Checkout.js:554) — the `onPayment` function, which shows the request target, `POST` method, and every backend field name (`shippingQuote`, `currency`, the `payment` object; `isAgree` and `message` are that page's terms checkbox and order-notes fields).
- [src/util/constant.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g3_checkout_request/no_okf/codex/5/src/util/constant.js:12) — the `CART: 'cart/'` and `CHECKOUT: 'checkout'` segments that form the path.
- [README.md](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g3_checkout_request/no_okf/codex/5/README.md) / [.env](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g3_checkout_request/no_okf/codex/5/.env) — confirming the backend is the separate Shopizer platform, not present here.

One caveat: the backend's order request class itself isn't in this repo, so the two fields Checkout.js doesn't send in its request body (`isAgree`, `message`) are taken from the names Checkout.js uses for the terms checkbox and order notes — the only backend-bound names for those in the codebase. No other files were touched.
